# GQL ISO/IEC 39075:2024 — Grammar Coverage

*Auto-generated by `cargo xtask gql-coverage`.  Do not hand-edit.*

This file tracks how much of the vendored ISO/IEC 39075:2024
reference grammar (`tck/opengql-grammar/GQL.g4`, manifest in
`rules.json`) the cyrs front-end parses.  A parser production
is **covered** when at least one conformance scenario that
lists it in a `@covers:` tag is *accepted* by the parser in
`DialectMode::GqlAligned` (zero syntax errors).

Coverage is a parser-*acceptance* measure: it shows the query
surface cyrs accepts, not runtime semantics (the front-end
does no execution, spec §1.3 N1).  The uncovered list below is
the worklist for growing the corpus — every entry is a
candidate for a new ISO-§-cited scenario.
